title: ExxonMobil 2024 Annual Report
body: We are committed to providing affordable energy while reducing emissions. We support market-based mechanisms for carbon pricing, including a carbon tax with revenue recycled to consumers. Our Low Carbon Solutions business is investing $20B over five years.

title: Darren Woods at CERAWeek 2024
body: The energy transition will take decades. We need a balanced approach. Aggressive policies that constrain supply before alternatives are at scale will hurt consumers and harm energy security. We oppose policies that ban specific technologies.

title: Shell Capital Markets Day 2024
body: Shell supports the goals of the Paris Agreement. We will achieve net-zero by 2050. We support a strong global price on carbon. We are investing in renewable power and biofuels at scale.

title: Shell CDP Climate Response 2024
body: Shell publicly endorses the IPCC AR6 conclusions on the urgency of emissions reductions. We support government regulation of methane emissions and well-designed carbon pricing systems.

title: BP Reimagine Energy Campaign UK
body: We're getting to net-zero. By 2030 we'll have 50 GW of renewables capacity and EV charging across the UK.

title: TotalEnergies EU Transparency Register entry
body: TotalEnergies engages with the EU on the Net Zero Industry Act and the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism. Position: support a phased CBAM with provisions to protect EU competitiveness.

title: API Letter to EPA on Methane Rule
body: The proposed methane rule will impose excessive costs on small operators without commensurate environmental benefit. We urge the EPA to substantially weaken the leak detection requirements and extend compliance timelines.

title: ACEA Submission on EU 2035 ICE Phase-out
body: ACEA cannot support the proposed 2035 ICE phase-out without flexibility for e-fuels and a level playing field for synthetic fuels. We oppose the regulation as drafted.

title: NextEra CDP Climate Response 2024
body: NextEra strongly supports renewable energy policies including extension of the production tax credit. We support carbon pricing as the most economically efficient way to reduce emissions.

title: VW Group CEO at Munich Mobility 2024
body: Volkswagen supports the EU's 2035 transition target. We will not lobby against it. We see e-mobility as the only viable path for passenger vehicles.

title: Toyota Hydrogen Strategy 2024
body: Toyota believes a multi-pathway approach including hydrogen and hybrids is essential. We caution against policies that mandate a single technology. We oppose 2035 ICE bans without credit for hybrid technologies.

title: U.S. Chamber Energy & Climate Position Paper 2024
body: The Chamber supports an all-of-the-above energy strategy. We oppose policies that pick winners and losers among technologies. We are concerned that aggressive emissions targets will harm U.S. competitiveness.
